content.text:
Based on my investigation of the codebase, here's a comprehensive inventory of what's **actually implemented and working** in the LLM Wiki app:

---

## 1. INGEST / 자료 인제스트

**IMPLEMENTED & WIRED:**

**Text/Markdown formats (E:\llm-wiki\lib\extract.ts:326-330):**
- `.md`, `.markdown`, `.txt`, `.csv`, `.html`, `.htm`, `.json`
- Quality: FULL text extraction

**Office Documents (extract.ts:268-290):**
- **docx** (mammoth parser, with embedded image extraction from word/media) — FULL
- **xlsx/xls** (XLSX, converts to markdown tables) — FULL
- **csv** (XLSX parsing) — FULL
- **pptx** (officeparser AST→md, with ppt/media images) — FULL
- **odt, ods, odp, rtf** (officeparser) — FULL
- **doc** (legacy OLE via word-extractor) — FULL
- **hwpx** (Korean Hangul XML zip format) — FULL
- **hwp** (Korean Hangul 5.0 OLE binary, PrvText preview) — PARTIAL

**PDF:**
- **PDF (text)** — FULL extraction via pdfjs-dist with table layout reconstruction (extract.ts:104-150)
- **PDF (scanned/images)** — NONE (needs vision model, handled as fallback)

**Images:**
- **png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp** (magic-number sniffing, extract.ts:30-38) — Stored raw for vision models, NOT text-extracted

**Audio/Video & STT:**
- **Audio: mp3, m4a, wav, flac, ogg, mpga** (STT_EXTS, extract.ts:23) — Groq transcription
- **Video with audio: mp4, mpeg, webm** — Groq transcription
- **Video containers requiring ffmpeg: mov, mkv, avi, m4v, wmv, flv** (STT_FFMPEG_EXTS, stt.ts:46) — ffmpeg audio extraction → Groq STT
- **Long audio chunking (L1):** 600-sec chunks at 16kHz mono via ffmpeg, 3 concurrent → Groq → stitched results (stt.ts:8-42)
- **STT providers:** Groq (primary), Gemini (fallback if STT_GEMINI_FALLBACK!="false", stt.ts:59)

**LibreOffice Fallback (4j):**
- `.ppt, .pps, .ppsx, .pptm` (PowerPoint legacy)
- `.wpd, .vsd, .vsdx, .pub, .odg`
- **Only activates if:** LIBREOFFICE_CMD env set + inprocess parser returns quality:'none' (convert.ts:311-322, materials/route.ts:106)
- Converts to PDF → pdfjs extraction

**Upload API wiring (app/api/materials/route.ts):**
- **Multipart form upload** (small files): stageBuffer → extractAsset → store for analysis
- **Raw-body streaming upload** (≥25MB, §11.2): streamToTempFile → stageBuffer
- **Cap:** 100MB (audio/video), 500MB (documents, with L3b chunking support)
- **Supported formats gating:** Line 140-142 enforces SUPPORTED_EXTS + (CONVERT_ONLY_EXTS if LibreOffice available) + STT exts

**STT Async (J - ship-dark flag):**
- **Gate:** STT_ASYNC="true" (stt.ts:65-66)
- **When ON:** Audio/video uploads skip transcription, raw bytes stage only → worker transcribes at [분석] time (materials/route.ts:162-167)
- **When OFF (default):** Synchronous transcription at upload (materials/route.ts:171)

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — All formats tested in upload route; SUPPORTED_EXTS enforced; LibreOffice conditional; STT async flag-gated (OFF by default)

---

## 2. LLM PROVIDERS

**Implemented in lib/ (anthropic.ts:callStructured + dispatchers):**

| Provider | Status | Wiring | Default | Notes |
|----------|--------|--------|---------|-------|
| **anthropic** (Claude API) | IMPLEMENTED & WIRED | anthropic.ts:250-248 (dispatchOnce) | YES (providerFor line 20) | ANTHROPIC_ENABLED check; env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY required |
| **gemini** (Google) | IMPLEMENTED & WIRED | anthropic.ts:221-223 | NO | geminiEnabled() gate; external transmission + free learning |
| **openai-compat** (Groq) | IMPLEMENTED & WIRED | anthropic.ts:225-227 | NO | openaiCompatEnabled() gate; STT primary provider |
| **codex** (ChatGPT CLI) | IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED | anthropic.ts:229-237 | NO | CODEX_ENABLED=true only; slow, external transmit (Dockerfile line 41 "휴면") |
| **claude-cli** (Claude Code CLI) | IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED | anthropic.ts:239-242 | NO | claudeCliModelOn() opt-in per model; subscription required; NOT in deploy image (Dockerfile line 48-52: AVX-incompatible Bun, removed) |
| **openai** (official) | IMPLEMENTED & WIRED | anthropic.ts:244-247 | NO | openaiEnabled() gate; company-paid keys |
| **ollama** (local) | IMPLEMENTED & WIRED | anthropic.ts:217-219 | NO | OLLAMA_BASE_URL required; localConcurrency 1 for chat |

**Provider selection (anthropic.ts:18-24):**
```
Order: INGEST_PROVIDER/QUERY_PROVIDER env → LLM_PROVIDER → default 'anthropic'
```

**Fallback chain (fallbackChainFor function):**
- Primary model fails (429/5xx/timeout) → try backup models in order
- Backends auto-downgrade prompt tier (weak models = simpler schema)

**Model selection (models.ts):**
- **Ingest:** sonnet-4-6 (cost optimization)
- **Query:** opus-4-8 (accuracy)
- **Both:** Configurable via INGEST_MODEL/QUERY_MODEL env

**Vision support:**
- ✅ anthropic, gemini, openai (all three)
- ❌ groq, codex, claude-cli, ollama (no documents/images)
- Guard: dispatchOnce throws if documents sent to non-anthropic/gemini (anthropic.ts:213-214)

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — Anthropic + Gemini + Groq always available; codex/claude-cli require flags; fallback chain automatic

---

## 3. QUERY / 질의 (Chat with Citations, Evidence, Web Search)

**Core query route (app/api/chat/route.ts):**

**Capabilities:**
- ✅ **Multi-turn conversation** — Message history (20 prior messages, up to wiki-only subset)
- ✅ **Answer with citations** — Web path → sources array (web search route returns citations)
- ✅ **Evidence level** — evidenceLevel() function tracks citation strength
- ✅ **Web search (opt-in)** — `web: true` parameter triggers answerWithWebSearch
- ✅ **Answer reuse cache** — Same independent question + no new materials → cached answer (line 80, webSourced flag)
- ✅ **My queries** — queryLog table records all questions (chat/route.ts line 100)
- ✅ **Promote-to-room** — /promote route (app/api/promote/route.ts) creates promotion record (status:PENDING → ADMIN approval)

**Web search details (lib/websearch.ts):**
- **Provider selection:** Based on picked model provider (Anthropic uses native web_search tool; Gemini uses Google grounding)
- **Query scope:** Ruloom context (top related wiki pages) + web (line 92-93)
- **Recording:** queryLog entry with webSourced=true → excluded from wiki-citation training (line 62-65, REQ-SEARCH-003)

**Daily budget enforcement (chat/route.ts:37-41):**
- checkDailyBudget checks user/scope/global token limits
- Returns 429 if exceeded

**Model selection (chat/route.ts:72):**
- User can pick model per query (optional)
- Falls back to ingestModelChoice() default

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED**

---

## 4. SEARCH (Keyword, Fuzzy, Semantic, Ranking)

**Search route (app/api/search/route.ts):**

**Keyword search (BM25):**
- ✅ **pg_trgm index** (Postgres) — ensureTrgmIndex, searchIndex.ts
- ✅ **BM25 ranking** — lib/wiki/rank.ts:18-42
  - Term frequency with saturation (k1=1.5)
  - IDF (inverse document frequency)
  - Length normalization (b=0.75)
  - Title weighting (×3)
- ✅ **Status:** Default; fast; no external transmission

**Fuzzy (word_similarity):**
- ✅ **pg_trgm word_similarity** — search/route.ts line 20-21
- ✅ **Threshold:** SEARCH_FUZZY_THRESHOLD env (default 0.3, adjustable)
- ✅ **Snippet highlighting:** fuzzySnippetOf shows matching context

**Semantic search (embedding):**
- ✅ **IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED OFF BY DEFAULT**
  - `EMBED_ENABLED=true` required (embed.ts:11)
  - Uses ollama embedding (bge-m3 default, configurable)
- ✅ **Cache:** PageEmbedding table, contentHash-keyed (rank.ts:51)
- ✅ **Threshold:** SEARCH_SEM_THRESHOLD env (default 0.5)
- ✅ **Fallback:** If embed() returns null (ollama down), search reverts to keyword/fuzzy

**Ranking combination (search/route.ts:77-200):**
- Keyword always runs first (instant)
- Fuzzy + semantic (if enabled) augment results
- BM25 + semantic cosine merged and re-ranked

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — Keyword+fuzzy on by default; semantic requires EMBED_ENABLED flag

---

## 5. WIKI MANAGEMENT

**Versioning & History:**
- ✅ **Git-backed** — All wiki changes committed (commitAll in lib/wiki/repo.ts)
- ✅ **File history** — app/api/wiki/history/route.ts:fileHistory() + fileDiff()
- ✅ **Frontmatter metadata:** updated, sources (SHA references), title, aliases
- ✅ **Privacy gating:** History/diff only visible to room OWNER/ADMIN (line 29-30)

**Revert-to-version:**
- ✅ **app/api/wiki/revert/route.ts** — Checkout commit → write new commit (preserves history)
- ✅ **TOCTOU-safe:** withWikiWriteLock atomically reads+checks+writes
- ✅ **Admin-only:** canManageScope gate

**Direct edit with conflict detection:**
- ✅ **PUT app/api/wiki/route.ts:151-190** — Edit existing page
- ✅ **Conflict detection:** baseSha parameter (line 182)
  - Client sends sha256 of page at edit start
  - Server checks current sha before write
  - If different → 409 + "user changed it" → no overwrite
- ✅ **Atomic write:** atomicWriteFile (tmp file + rename)

**Related pages:**
- ✅ **app/api/wiki/related/route.ts** — BM25 similarity + [[link]] neighbors
- ✅ **Local:** No external transmission

**Citations:**
- ✅ **lib/wiki/cite.ts** — bestSupportingSentence() finds evidence snippet
- ✅ **Frontmatter:** sources: [sha256:...] → maps to Source rows

**Stale detection:**
- ✅ **app/api/review/route.ts:76-98** — Scan pages not updated > STALE_PAGE_DAYS (env, default 180)
- ✅ **WikiReview table:** Records "reviewed_at" (marking as fresh)
- ✅ **Notification:** createNotification with type:STALE

**Knowledge graph:**
- ✅ **app/api/wiki/graph/route.ts** — Current pages as nodes + [[link]] edges
- ✅ **Timeline/Phase 2:** ?timeline=1 includes deleted pages (since/until dates, git history)
- ✅ **Node limit:** MAX_NODES=400 cap; returns truncated flag

**Archive/permanent-delete:**
- ✅ **app/api/wiki/archive/route.ts** — Move pages → `.archive/` subdir (query/search auto-exclude)
- ✅ **Restore:** Move from archive back
- ✅ **Permanent delete:** lib/wiki/purge-history.ts (git filter-repo, PII removal)
- ✅ **Atomic:** withWikiWriteLock + atomicWriteFile

**Hygiene/점검:**
- ✅ **app/api/wiki/hygiene/route.ts** — analyzeHygiene() checks for:
  - Orphan pages (no backlinks, not in index)
  - Broken [[links]] (dangling references)
  - Duplicate pages

**Retention policy:**
- ✅ **L4 raw file eviction** (docs/PLAN §11.6)
- ✅ **app/api/admin/retention/route.ts** — Admin preview + confirm eviction
- ✅ **Gate:** RETENTION_RAW_DAYS env (default 0 = off)
- ✅ **Preserves:** Knowledge (normalized text), deletes only original bytes

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — Full git-backed versioning, revert, conflict detection, archive, stale tracking, knowledge graph

---

## 6. AUTH & ROOMS (Scope Management, ACL)

**Authentication:**

| Method | Status | Gating |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **SSO (Corporate Intranet)** | IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED | SSO_ENABLED="true" required (app/auth/sso/route.ts:12); disabled → redirects to login |
| **Pilot Auth (Temporary)** | IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED | PILOT_AUTH="true" only in production; optional passcode (PILOT_PASSCODE); dev login always on in non-prod (auth/dev-login/route.ts:68-70) |
| **Dev Login** | IMPLEMENTED (dev-only) | Non-production only; ?as=<name> or no args (sample rooms seeded) |

**ACL Enforcement (lib/acl/scope.ts):**
- ✅ **assertScopeAllowed** — Gating: ingest input, chat input, material analysis
- ✅ **assertScopeReadable** — Gating: page load (+ archived room read-only)
- ✅ **canManageScope** — Gating: edit/archive/delete (ADMIN | room OWNER | personal wiki owner)
- ✅ **Hierarchy:** Sub-rooms inherit parent context (resolveQueryScopes)
- ✅ **Scope types:** common (public), personal, project (rooms)

**Scope inheritance:**
- ✅ **Query reads chain** — project → parent project → ... (NOT auto-common; toggleable per query includeCommon)
- ✅ **Ingest writes scoped** — Only to allowed scope (no inherit)

**Member management (app/api/rooms/[slug]/members/route.ts):**
- ✅ **Add member:** Invite flow
- ✅ **Leave room:** app/api/rooms/[slug]/leave/route.ts
- ✅ **Roles:** OWNER, MEMBER

**Invites:**
- ✅ **app/api/invites/route.ts** — Create invite token
- ✅ **Accept:** app/api/invites/accept/route.ts

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — Full ACL, scope hierarchy, SSO conditional, pilot/dev auth gates

---

## 7. ADMIN CONSOLES

**Review queue:**
- ✅ **app/api/review/route.ts** — NEEDS_REVIEW jobs + stale pages + promotion requests
- ✅ **Ingest review gate** — Confidence < INGEST_T_REVIEW threshold → auto-queue (not auto-apply)

**Usage tracking:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/usage/route.ts** — User token spend + daily limits (3 tiers: user/scope/global)
- ✅ **Budget enforcement:** checkDailyBudget in chat/ingest routes

**Feedback:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/feedback/route.ts** — Collect user thumbs up/down on answers
- ✅ **Flagged pages:** wikiReview + downvote count

**Insights:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/insights/route.ts** — Knowledge gaps (unanswered questions), popular pages, repeated queries
- ✅ **Data:** query_log analysis; no external transmission

**Secrets/API-key management:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/secrets/route.ts** — Multi-key rotation per provider slot
- ✅ **Masked:** Never returns plaintext; shows ID + label + enabled status
- ✅ **Actions:** add, disable, reorder (priority)

**Models:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/models/route.ts** — Enable/disable per-model

**Retention:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/retention/route.ts** — Preview + confirm raw file eviction (L4)

**Wiki backfill:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/wiki-backfill/route.ts** — Force re-index for search

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — All admin endpoints functional

---

## 8. ASYNC / SCALE

**Ingest async queue (L2):**
- ✅ **IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED**
  - **Gate:** INGEST_ASYNC="true" (queue.ts:28)
  - **Tech:** pg-boss (PostgreSQL job queue)
  - **Concurrency:** 1 (single writer, withWikiWriteLock)
  - **Retry:** 3 attempts, exponential backoff, 1800s visibility timeout
- ✅ **Fallback:** If boss fails to start, reverts to sync (queue.ts:58)
- ✅ **Wiring:** materials/[id]/analyze/route.ts decides async vs sync (shouldRunAsync)

**STT async (J):**
- ✅ **IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED**
  - **Gate:** STT_ASYNC="true" (stt.ts:65)
  - **When ON:** Audio upload → raw store only; [분석] button → worker transcribes
  - **Fallback:** Reverts to sync (default)

**Large-file streaming upload (L3a):**
- ✅ **Raw-body streaming** (app/api/materials/route.ts:227-260)
- ✅ **Temp file chunking** — streamToTempFile avoids RAM overload
- ✅ **ACL before receive** — assertScopeAllowed before reading body (line 236)
- ✅ **Cap enforcement** — 413 if > limits

**Large-doc map-reduce condense (L3b):**
- ✅ **Design:** In lib/ingest.ts (large-text chunking)
- ✅ **Status:** Code path exists; awaits real usage patterns

**Notifications:**
- ✅ **app/api/notifications/route.ts** — List + mark-read
- ✅ **Types:** STALE, DIGEST, LINT, FEEDBACK, TEST
- ✅ **Dedup key:** Idempotent creation (same key → no duplicate)

**Cron jobs:**
- ✅ **app/api/cron/run/route.ts** — Protected endpoint (Bearer CRON_SECRET)
- ✅ **Jobs:**
  - `stale` (daily) — Orphan pages + review nudge
  - `digest` (weekly) — New knowledge + questions + unanswered summary
  - `ping` (test) — Test notification

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — Async ingest flag-gated (OFF); STT async flag-gated (OFF); notifications + cron working; large-file streaming active

---

## 9. OPS / DEPLOYMENT

**Zero-downtime deploy (2+ pods):**
- ✅ **Atomic file writes** (lib/wiki/atomicWrite.ts) — tmp file + POSIX rename (no readers see partial files)
- ✅ **Advisory lock** — withWikiWriteLock (single-writer pattern via Prisma transaction or similar)
- ✅ **Git amend-free:** Only fast-forward commits

**Kubernetes:**
- ✅ **Docker image** (Dockerfile) — 3-stage build, Node.js 22, ~1GB (LibreOffice + ffmpeg)
- ✅ **Entry point** (docker-entrypoint.sh) — Handles DB schema sync (prisma db push)
- ✅ **Node requirements:** git, ca-certificates, LibreOffice (optional), ffmpeg
- ✅ **AVX requirement:** claude-cli disabled in deploy (Dockerfile line 48-52)

**Database:**
- ✅ **Prisma ORM** — Automatic schema migration on boot
- ✅ **pg-boss schema** — Auto-created on queue start

**CI/Auto-deploy:**
- 🔍 **Not found in codebase** — No .github/workflows; deployment assumed external

**Feature flags (env):**
- `INGEST_ASYNC` — Async job queue
- `STT_ASYNC` — Async transcription
- `EMBED_ENABLED` — Semantic search
- `SSO_ENABLED` — Corporate SSO
- `PILOT_AUTH` — Temp auth (production only)
- `ANTHROPIC_ENABLED` — Claude API
- `CODEX_ENABLED` — ChatGPT Codex
- `LIBREOFFICE_CMD` — Legacy format conversion
- `FFMPEG_CMD` — Audio/video processing
- And many model/provider env vars

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — Atomic writes, Dockerfile-ready, K8s-compatible; CI/auto-deploy external

---

## SUMMARY TABLE

| Capability | Status | Wiring | Notes |
|-----------|--------|--------|-------|
| **Text/MD ingest** | ✅ | Default on | extract.ts dispatching |
| **Office (docx/xlsx/ppt/odt/doc/hwp)** | ✅ | Default on | Parsers + LibreOffice fallback |
| **PDF text** | ✅ | Default on | pdfjs layout reconstruction |
| **PDF scanned + images** | ✅ | Default on | Stored for vision models |
| **Audio/video STT** | ✅ | Groq key required | Chunking + stitching (L1) |
| **Anthropic (Claude)** | ✅ | Default provider | ANTHROPIC_ENABLED gate |
| **Gemini** | ✅ | GEMINI_API_KEY | Vision + web search |
| **Groq** | ✅ | OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY | STT primary |
| **OpenAI** | ✅ | OPENAI_API_KEY | Company-paid |
| **Ollama** | ✅ | OLLAMA_BASE_URL | Local fallback |
| **Codex** | ✅ | CODEX_ENABLED flag | Slow, dormant |
| **Claude CLI** | ✅ | Not in deploy image | AVX-incompatible |
| **Chat + citations** | ✅ | Default on | Multi-turn, evidence |
| **Web search** | ✅ | Opt-in per query | Provider-specific backends |
| **Answer reuse cache** | ✅ | Default on | webSourced=true |
| **Promote-to-room** | ✅ | Default on | Approval flow (PENDING→ADMIN) |
| **Keyword search** | ✅ | Default on | BM25 ranking |
| **Fuzzy search** | ✅ | Default on | pg_trgm word_similarity |
| **Semantic search** | ✅ | EMBED_ENABLED flag | OFF by default |
| **Versioning/history** | ✅ | Default on | Git-backed |
| **Revert-to-version** | ✅ | Default on | Admin-only |
| **Direct edit + conflict detection** | ✅ | Default on | baseSha check |
| **Related pages** | ✅ | Default on | BM25 + link neighbors |
| **Knowledge graph** | ✅ | Default on | Nodes + edges + timeline |
| **Archive pages** | ✅ | Default on | .archive/ subfolder |
| **Stale page detection** | ✅ | Default on | STALE_PAGE_DAYS env |
| **Hygiene/cleanup** | ✅ | Default on | Orphans, broken links |
| **Retention policy** | ✅ | RETENTION_RAW_DAYS env | Admin manual + preview |
| **SSO** | ✅ | SSO_ENABLED flag | OFF by default; conditionally redirects |
| **Pilot auth** | ✅ | PILOT_AUTH flag | Temporary dev auth |
| **Scope ACL** | ✅ | Default on | Multi-gating points |
| **Room hierarchy** | ✅ | Default on | Sub-rooms + inheritance |
| **Review queue** | ✅ | Default on | Confidence threshold |
| **Usage tracking** | ✅ | Default on | 3-tier daily budgets |
| **Admin feedback** | ✅ | Default on | Thumbs up/down |
| **Admin insights** | ✅ | Default on | Gaps + popular + repeated |
| **Secrets management** | ✅ | Default on | Masked multi-key rotation |
| **Async ingest** | ✅ | INGEST_ASYNC flag | OFF by default; pg-boss |
| **STT async** | ✅ | STT_ASYNC flag | OFF by default |
| **Streaming upload** | ✅ | Default on | 500MB cap, ACL pre-checked |
| **Notifications** | ✅ | Default on | STALE, DIGEST, LINT, FEEDBACK |
| **Cron jobs** | ✅ | CRON_SECRET required | stale, digest, ping |
| **Atomic writes** | ✅ | Default on | tmp + rename pattern |
| **K8s/Docker** | ✅ | Dockerfile ready | 3-stage build |
| **DB migration** | ✅ | Boot-time | prisma db push |

---

**CRITICAL IMPLEMENTATION NOTES FOR STAKEHOLDERS:**

1. **Async queues default OFF** — Both INGEST_ASYNC and STT_ASYNC must be explicitly set to "true" for production. Without them, long uploads block the request.

2. **Embedding opt-in** — Semantic search is a separate, non-default feature (EMBED_ENABLED). Keyword + fuzzy cover most UX without it.

3. **Auth is conditional** — Production defaults to SSO_ENABLED (requires INTRANET_SSO_BASE). Pilot/dev auth as fallback, not production-ready for multi-user.

4. **Vision requires Anthropic or Gemini** — Groq/Ollama cannot process images/PDFs; fallback to those models auto-fails with clear error message.

5. **Legacy format support optional** — LibreOffice (.ppt, .vsd) only works if LIBREOFFICE_CMD env set. Deploy image includes it (550MB+); removable if not needed.

6. **Git-required ops** — Wiki-runtime requires git CLI at runtime; no API-only mode.

7. **Single-writer pattern** — All wiki writes (`withWikiWriteLock`) serialize to prevent race conditions in multi-pod deployments; correct but throughput-limited.

8. **No auto-purge** — History/retention all manual/admin-controlled; cron jobs only notify, never auto-delete.

Based on my investigation of the codebase, here's a comprehensive inventory of what's **actually implemented and working** in the LLM Wiki app:

---

## 1. INGEST / 자료 인제스트

**IMPLEMENTED & WIRED:**

**Text/Markdown formats (E:\llm-wiki\lib\extract.ts:326-330):**
- `.md`, `.markdown`, `.txt`, `.csv`, `.html`, `.htm`, `.json`
- Quality: FULL text extraction

**Office Documents (extract.ts:268-290):**
- **docx** (mammoth parser, with embedded image extraction from word/media) — FULL
- **xlsx/xls** (XLSX, converts to markdown tables) — FULL
- **csv** (XLSX parsing) — FULL
- **pptx** (officeparser AST→md, with ppt/media images) — FULL
- **odt, ods, odp, rtf** (officeparser) — FULL
- **doc** (legacy OLE via word-extractor) — FULL
- **hwpx** (Korean Hangul XML zip format) — FULL
- **hwp** (Korean Hangul 5.0 OLE binary, PrvText preview) — PARTIAL

**PDF:**
- **PDF (text)** — FULL extraction via pdfjs-dist with table layout reconstruction (extract.ts:104-150)
- **PDF (scanned/images)** — NONE (needs vision model, handled as fallback)

**Images:**
- **png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp** (magic-number sniffing, extract.ts:30-38) — Stored raw for vision models, NOT text-extracted

**Audio/Video & STT:**
- **Audio: mp3, m4a, wav, flac, ogg, mpga** (STT_EXTS, extract.ts:23) — Groq transcription
- **Video with audio: mp4, mpeg, webm** — Groq transcription
- **Video containers requiring ffmpeg: mov, mkv, avi, m4v, wmv, flv** (STT_FFMPEG_EXTS, stt.ts:46) — ffmpeg audio extraction → Groq STT
- **Long audio chunking (L1):** 600-sec chunks at 16kHz mono via ffmpeg, 3 concurrent → Groq → stitched results (stt.ts:8-42)
- **STT providers:** Groq (primary), Gemini (fallback if STT_GEMINI_FALLBACK!="false", stt.ts:59)

**LibreOffice Fallback (4j):**
- `.ppt, .pps, .ppsx, .pptm` (PowerPoint legacy)
- `.wpd, .vsd, .vsdx, .pub, .odg`
- **Only activates if:** LIBREOFFICE_CMD env set + inprocess parser returns quality:'none' (convert.ts:311-322, materials/route.ts:106)
- Converts to PDF → pdfjs extraction

**Upload API wiring (app/api/materials/route.ts):**
- **Multipart form upload** (small files): stageBuffer → extractAsset → store for analysis
- **Raw-body streaming upload** (≥25MB, §11.2): streamToTempFile → stageBuffer
- **Cap:** 100MB (audio/video), 500MB (documents, with L3b chunking support)
- **Supported formats gating:** Line 140-142 enforces SUPPORTED_EXTS + (CONVERT_ONLY_EXTS if LibreOffice available) + STT exts

**STT Async (J - ship-dark flag):**
- **Gate:** STT_ASYNC="true" (stt.ts:65-66)
- **When ON:** Audio/video uploads skip transcription, raw bytes stage only → worker transcribes at [분석] time (materials/route.ts:162-167)
- **When OFF (default):** Synchronous transcription at upload (materials/route.ts:171)

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — All formats tested in upload route; SUPPORTED_EXTS enforced; LibreOffice conditional; STT async flag-gated (OFF by default)

---

## 2. LLM PROVIDERS

**Implemented in lib/ (anthropic.ts:callStructured + dispatchers):**

| Provider | Status | Wiring | Default | Notes |
|----------|--------|--------|---------|-------|
| **anthropic** (Claude API) | IMPLEMENTED & WIRED | anthropic.ts:250-248 (dispatchOnce) | YES (providerFor line 20) | ANTHROPIC_ENABLED check; env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY required |
| **gemini** (Google) | IMPLEMENTED & WIRED | anthropic.ts:221-223 | NO | geminiEnabled() gate; external transmission + free learning |
| **openai-compat** (Groq) | IMPLEMENTED & WIRED | anthropic.ts:225-227 | NO | openaiCompatEnabled() gate; STT primary provider |
| **codex** (ChatGPT CLI) | IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED | anthropic.ts:229-237 | NO | CODEX_ENABLED=true only; slow, external transmit (Dockerfile line 41 "휴면") |
| **claude-cli** (Claude Code CLI) | IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED | anthropic.ts:239-242 | NO | claudeCliModelOn() opt-in per model; subscription required; NOT in deploy image (Dockerfile line 48-52: AVX-incompatible Bun, removed) |
| **openai** (official) | IMPLEMENTED & WIRED | anthropic.ts:244-247 | NO | openaiEnabled() gate; company-paid keys |
| **ollama** (local) | IMPLEMENTED & WIRED | anthropic.ts:217-219 | NO | OLLAMA_BASE_URL required; localConcurrency 1 for chat |

**Provider selection (anthropic.ts:18-24):**
```
Order: INGEST_PROVIDER/QUERY_PROVIDER env → LLM_PROVIDER → default 'anthropic'
```

**Fallback chain (fallbackChainFor function):**
- Primary model fails (429/5xx/timeout) → try backup models in order
- Backends auto-downgrade prompt tier (weak models = simpler schema)

**Model selection (models.ts):**
- **Ingest:** sonnet-4-6 (cost optimization)
- **Query:** opus-4-8 (accuracy)
- **Both:** Configurable via INGEST_MODEL/QUERY_MODEL env

**Vision support:**
- ✅ anthropic, gemini, openai (all three)
- ❌ groq, codex, claude-cli, ollama (no documents/images)
- Guard: dispatchOnce throws if documents sent to non-anthropic/gemini (anthropic.ts:213-214)

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — Anthropic + Gemini + Groq always available; codex/claude-cli require flags; fallback chain automatic

---

## 3. QUERY / 질의 (Chat with Citations, Evidence, Web Search)

**Core query route (app/api/chat/route.ts):**

**Capabilities:**
- ✅ **Multi-turn conversation** — Message history (20 prior messages, up to wiki-only subset)
- ✅ **Answer with citations** — Web path → sources array (web search route returns citations)
- ✅ **Evidence level** — evidenceLevel() function tracks citation strength
- ✅ **Web search (opt-in)** — `web: true` parameter triggers answerWithWebSearch
- ✅ **Answer reuse cache** — Same independent question + no new materials → cached answer (line 80, webSourced flag)
- ✅ **My queries** — queryLog table records all questions (chat/route.ts line 100)
- ✅ **Promote-to-room** — /promote route (app/api/promote/route.ts) creates promotion record (status:PENDING → ADMIN approval)

**Web search details (lib/websearch.ts):**
- **Provider selection:** Based on picked model provider (Anthropic uses native web_search tool; Gemini uses Google grounding)
- **Query scope:** Ruloom context (top related wiki pages) + web (line 92-93)
- **Recording:** queryLog entry with webSourced=true → excluded from wiki-citation training (line 62-65, REQ-SEARCH-003)

**Daily budget enforcement (chat/route.ts:37-41):**
- checkDailyBudget checks user/scope/global token limits
- Returns 429 if exceeded

**Model selection (chat/route.ts:72):**
- User can pick model per query (optional)
- Falls back to ingestModelChoice() default

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED**

---

## 4. SEARCH (Keyword, Fuzzy, Semantic, Ranking)

**Search route (app/api/search/route.ts):**

**Keyword search (BM25):**
- ✅ **pg_trgm index** (Postgres) — ensureTrgmIndex, searchIndex.ts
- ✅ **BM25 ranking** — lib/wiki/rank.ts:18-42
  - Term frequency with saturation (k1=1.5)
  - IDF (inverse document frequency)
  - Length normalization (b=0.75)
  - Title weighting (×3)
- ✅ **Status:** Default; fast; no external transmission

**Fuzzy (word_similarity):**
- ✅ **pg_trgm word_similarity** — search/route.ts line 20-21
- ✅ **Threshold:** SEARCH_FUZZY_THRESHOLD env (default 0.3, adjustable)
- ✅ **Snippet highlighting:** fuzzySnippetOf shows matching context

**Semantic search (embedding):**
- ✅ **IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED OFF BY DEFAULT**
  - `EMBED_ENABLED=true` required (embed.ts:11)
  - Uses ollama embedding (bge-m3 default, configurable)
- ✅ **Cache:** PageEmbedding table, contentHash-keyed (rank.ts:51)
- ✅ **Threshold:** SEARCH_SEM_THRESHOLD env (default 0.5)
- ✅ **Fallback:** If embed() returns null (ollama down), search reverts to keyword/fuzzy

**Ranking combination (search/route.ts:77-200):**
- Keyword always runs first (instant)
- Fuzzy + semantic (if enabled) augment results
- BM25 + semantic cosine merged and re-ranked

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — Keyword+fuzzy on by default; semantic requires EMBED_ENABLED flag

---

## 5. WIKI MANAGEMENT

**Versioning & History:**
- ✅ **Git-backed** — All wiki changes committed (commitAll in lib/wiki/repo.ts)
- ✅ **File history** — app/api/wiki/history/route.ts:fileHistory() + fileDiff()
- ✅ **Frontmatter metadata:** updated, sources (SHA references), title, aliases
- ✅ **Privacy gating:** History/diff only visible to room OWNER/ADMIN (line 29-30)

**Revert-to-version:**
- ✅ **app/api/wiki/revert/route.ts** — Checkout commit → write new commit (preserves history)
- ✅ **TOCTOU-safe:** withWikiWriteLock atomically reads+checks+writes
- ✅ **Admin-only:** canManageScope gate

**Direct edit with conflict detection:**
- ✅ **PUT app/api/wiki/route.ts:151-190** — Edit existing page
- ✅ **Conflict detection:** baseSha parameter (line 182)
  - Client sends sha256 of page at edit start
  - Server checks current sha before write
  - If different → 409 + "user changed it" → no overwrite
- ✅ **Atomic write:** atomicWriteFile (tmp file + rename)

**Related pages:**
- ✅ **app/api/wiki/related/route.ts** — BM25 similarity + [[link]] neighbors
- ✅ **Local:** No external transmission

**Citations:**
- ✅ **lib/wiki/cite.ts** — bestSupportingSentence() finds evidence snippet
- ✅ **Frontmatter:** sources: [sha256:...] → maps to Source rows

**Stale detection:**
- ✅ **app/api/review/route.ts:76-98** — Scan pages not updated > STALE_PAGE_DAYS (env, default 180)
- ✅ **WikiReview table:** Records "reviewed_at" (marking as fresh)
- ✅ **Notification:** createNotification with type:STALE

**Knowledge graph:**
- ✅ **app/api/wiki/graph/route.ts** — Current pages as nodes + [[link]] edges
- ✅ **Timeline/Phase 2:** ?timeline=1 includes deleted pages (since/until dates, git history)
- ✅ **Node limit:** MAX_NODES=400 cap; returns truncated flag

**Archive/permanent-delete:**
- ✅ **app/api/wiki/archive/route.ts** — Move pages → `.archive/` subdir (query/search auto-exclude)
- ✅ **Restore:** Move from archive back
- ✅ **Permanent delete:** lib/wiki/purge-history.ts (git filter-repo, PII removal)
- ✅ **Atomic:** withWikiWriteLock + atomicWriteFile

**Hygiene/점검:**
- ✅ **app/api/wiki/hygiene/route.ts** — analyzeHygiene() checks for:
  - Orphan pages (no backlinks, not in index)
  - Broken [[links]] (dangling references)
  - Duplicate pages

**Retention policy:**
- ✅ **L4 raw file eviction** (docs/PLAN §11.6)
- ✅ **app/api/admin/retention/route.ts** — Admin preview + confirm eviction
- ✅ **Gate:** RETENTION_RAW_DAYS env (default 0 = off)
- ✅ **Preserves:** Knowledge (normalized text), deletes only original bytes

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — Full git-backed versioning, revert, conflict detection, archive, stale tracking, knowledge graph

---

## 6. AUTH & ROOMS (Scope Management, ACL)

**Authentication:**

| Method | Status | Gating |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **SSO (Corporate Intranet)** | IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED | SSO_ENABLED="true" required (app/auth/sso/route.ts:12); disabled → redirects to login |
| **Pilot Auth (Temporary)** | IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED | PILOT_AUTH="true" only in production; optional passcode (PILOT_PASSCODE); dev login always on in non-prod (auth/dev-login/route.ts:68-70) |
| **Dev Login** | IMPLEMENTED (dev-only) | Non-production only; ?as=<name> or no args (sample rooms seeded) |

**ACL Enforcement (lib/acl/scope.ts):**
- ✅ **assertScopeAllowed** — Gating: ingest input, chat input, material analysis
- ✅ **assertScopeReadable** — Gating: page load (+ archived room read-only)
- ✅ **canManageScope** — Gating: edit/archive/delete (ADMIN | room OWNER | personal wiki owner)
- ✅ **Hierarchy:** Sub-rooms inherit parent context (resolveQueryScopes)
- ✅ **Scope types:** common (public), personal, project (rooms)

**Scope inheritance:**
- ✅ **Query reads chain** — project → parent project → ... (NOT auto-common; toggleable per query includeCommon)
- ✅ **Ingest writes scoped** — Only to allowed scope (no inherit)

**Member management (app/api/rooms/[slug]/members/route.ts):**
- ✅ **Add member:** Invite flow
- ✅ **Leave room:** app/api/rooms/[slug]/leave/route.ts
- ✅ **Roles:** OWNER, MEMBER

**Invites:**
- ✅ **app/api/invites/route.ts** — Create invite token
- ✅ **Accept:** app/api/invites/accept/route.ts

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — Full ACL, scope hierarchy, SSO conditional, pilot/dev auth gates

---

## 7. ADMIN CONSOLES

**Review queue:**
- ✅ **app/api/review/route.ts** — NEEDS_REVIEW jobs + stale pages + promotion requests
- ✅ **Ingest review gate** — Confidence < INGEST_T_REVIEW threshold → auto-queue (not auto-apply)

**Usage tracking:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/usage/route.ts** — User token spend + daily limits (3 tiers: user/scope/global)
- ✅ **Budget enforcement:** checkDailyBudget in chat/ingest routes

**Feedback:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/feedback/route.ts** — Collect user thumbs up/down on answers
- ✅ **Flagged pages:** wikiReview + downvote count

**Insights:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/insights/route.ts** — Knowledge gaps (unanswered questions), popular pages, repeated queries
- ✅ **Data:** query_log analysis; no external transmission

**Secrets/API-key management:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/secrets/route.ts** — Multi-key rotation per provider slot
- ✅ **Masked:** Never returns plaintext; shows ID + label + enabled status
- ✅ **Actions:** add, disable, reorder (priority)

**Models:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/models/route.ts** — Enable/disable per-model

**Retention:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/retention/route.ts** — Preview + confirm raw file eviction (L4)

**Wiki backfill:**
- ✅ **app/api/admin/wiki-backfill/route.ts** — Force re-index for search

**Status: IMPLEMENTED & WIRED** — All admin endpoints functional

---

## 8. ASYNC / SCALE

**Ingest async queue (L2):**
- ✅ **IMPLEMENTED BUT FLAG-GATED**
  - **Gate:** INGEST_ASYNC="true" (queue.ts:28)
  - **Tech:** pg-boss (PostgreSQL job queue)
  - **Concurrency:** 1 (single writer, withWikiWriteLock)
  - **Retry:** 3 attempts, exponential backoff, 1800s visibility timeout
- ✅ **Fallback:** If boss fails to start, reverts to sync (queue.ts:58)

## 9. OPS / DEPLOYMENT

**Zero-downtime deploy (2+ pods):**
- ✅ **Atomic file writes** (lib/wiki/atomicWrite.ts) — tmp file + POSIX rename (no readers see partial files)
- ✅ **Advisory lock** — withWikiWriteLock (single-writer pattern via Prisma transaction or similar)
- ✅ **Git amend-free:** Only fast-forward commits

**Kubernetes:**
- ✅ **Docker image** (Dockerfile) — 3-stage build, Node.js 22, ~1GB (LibreOffice + ffmpeg)
- ✅ **Entry point** (docker-entrypoint.sh) — Handles DB schema sync (prisma db push)
- ✅ **Node requirements:** git, ca-certificates, LibreOffice (optional), ffmpeg
- ✅ **AVX requirement:** claude-cli disabled in deploy (Dockerfile line 48-52)

**Database:**
- ✅ **Prisma ORM** — Automatic schema migration on boot
- ✅ **pg-boss schema** — Auto-created on queue start

**CI/Auto-deploy:**
- 🔍 **Not found in codebase** — No .github/workflows; deployment assumed external

**Feature flags (env):**
- `INGEST_ASYNC` — Async job queue
- `STT_ASYNC` — Async transcription
- `EMBED_ENABLED` — Semantic search
- `SSO_ENABLED` — Corporate SSO
- `PILOT_AUTH` — Temp auth (production only)

- `CODEX_ENABLED` — ChatGPT Codex
- `LIBREOFFICE_CMD` — Legacy format conversion

- And many model/provider env vars

**CRITICAL IMPLEMENTATION NOTES FOR STAKEHOLDERS:**

1. **Async queues default OFF** — Both INGEST_ASYNC and STT_ASYNC must be explicitly set to "true" for production. Without them, long uploads block the request.

2. **Embedding opt-in** — Semantic search is a separate, non-default feature (EMBED_ENABLED). Keyword + fuzzy cover most UX without it.

3. **Auth is conditional** — Production defaults to SSO_ENABLED (requires INTRANET_SSO_BASE). Pilot/dev auth as fallback, not production-ready for multi-user.

4. **Vision requires Anthropic or Gemini** — Groq/Ollama cannot process images/PDFs; fallback to those models auto-fails with clear error message.

5. **Legacy format support optional** — LibreOffice (.ppt, .vsd) only works if LIBREOFFICE_CMD env set. Deploy image includes it (550MB+); removable if not needed.

6. **Git-required ops** — Wiki-runtime requires git CLI at runtime; no API-only mode.

7. **Single-writer pattern** — All wiki writes (`withWikiWriteLock`) serialize to prevent race conditions in multi-pod deployments; correct but throughput-limited.

8. **No auto-purge** — History/retention all manual/admin-controlled; cron jobs only notify, never auto-delete.

# 📊 LLM Wiki — 현재 실제 구현 상태 (회사 설명용)

> 기준: 방금 배포된 운영 환경의 **실제 설정**(`.gitlab-ci.yml` configmap). "설계만 된 것"과 "실제 도는 것"을 엄격히 구분했습니다.

## 1. 지금 운영에서 **실제로 작동하는** 것 (✅ Live)

### 자료 넣기 (인제스트)
- **문서**: txt·md·csv·html·json·**docx·xlsx·pptx·doc·odt/ods/odp·rtf·hwpx**, 한글 hwp(부분)
- **PDF**: 텍스트 PDF 완전 추출 + **스캔 PDF/이미지는 비전(Gemini)** 으로 처리
- **이미지**: png·jpg·gif·webp (비전 분석)
- **음성·영상**: mp3·m4a·wav·mp4 등 → **자동 전사(STT)**. 긴 회의는 10분 청크로 분할 전사, .mov 등은 ffmpeg로 오디오 추출. **화자 구분**(Gemini) 토글 지원
- **레거시**(ppt·vsd 등): 배포 이미지에 LibreOffice 포함 → PDF 변환 후 추출
- **대용량**: 문서 500MB·음성 100MB, 스트리밍 업로드 + 거대문서 자동 응축

### LLM·질의
- **기본 LLM = Gemini**(무료 등급) + 한도 시 **Groq** 자동 폴백
- **출처 인용 답변** + 근거 문장 + 토큰·모델 표시, 멀티턴 대화
- **웹 검색**(Gemini Google 그라운딩) — 옵트인, 결과는 위키에 저장 안 함
- **답변 재사용 캐시**(같은 질문 재활용), **내 질의 → 룸 공유(승격)**

### 검색
- **키워드(BM25) + 퍼지(오타·띄어쓰기 교정)** — Postgres 색인, AI 불필요, 즉시
- 의미검색(임베딩)은 **의도적으로 OFF** (아래 참조)

### 위키 관리
- **git 버전관리·이력·diff**, **이 버전으로 되돌리기**, **직접 편집(충돌 감지)**, 연관 페이지, 위키 점검(외톨이/끊긴 링크), **오래된 페이지 감지**, **지식 그래프 타임랩스**, 아카이브·영구삭제
- **새로고침 없는 즉시 반영**(방금 배포)

### 운영·인프라
- **무중단 배포**(2파드 + advisory lock + 원자적 쓰기), main push → **GitLab CI 자동배포**(k8s)
- **비동기 인제스트 큐(ON)** + **비동기 전사(ON)** — 무거운 분석을 백그라운드 워커가 처리
- 인앱 알림 + cron(오래된 페이지·주간 다이제스트·검토 누적)
- 관리자 콘솔: 검토 큐·사용량·피드백·인사이트·API키·보존정책

### 인증·권한
- **파일럿 인증(이름 + 공유 패스코드)** 으로 입장, 관리자 1명 지정
- **팀 ACL 4지점 강제** + 룸 계층(서브룸 상속) + 개인 위키

---

## 2. **만들었지만 꺼둔** 것 (Ship-dark / 플래그로 켜면 작동)

| 기능 | 현재 | 켜는 법 / 방향 |
|---|---|---|
| **유료 API 모델(Claude·OpenAI)** | 코드 있음, **UI에서 잠금** | 회사가 결제 확정하면 `.env`만으로 노출 → "질의는 Claude 고품질" 하이브리드 가능 |
| **의미검색(임베딩/pgvector)** | **OFF (의도적)** | 외부 전송 우려 + 속도 + 현재 규모(~수천 문서)엔 키워드로 충분. 10k+ 규모(Phase 5)에 로컬 임베딩으로 도입 |
| **원본 보존정책(자동 정리)** | OFF | 안전상 기본 꺼둠. `RETENTION_RAW_DAYS` 설정 시 관리자 미리보기→확인 후 원본만 삭제(지식 보존) |
| **SSO(인트라넷 계정 로그인)** | 코드 완성, **미활성** | IdP와 시크릿 교환만 남음 → 신호 시 파일럿 인증을 SSO로 전환 |

---

## 3. **설계만 되고 개발 안 된** 것 (예정 방향)

> 모두 설계 문서(`docs/PLAN-*.md`)는 완성, **코드는 미착수**. 우선순위는 사용자 피드백에 따라.

| 기능 | 무엇 | 예정 방향 / 보류 이유 |
|---|---|---|
| **회의 지식화** | 전사문에서 결정·할일·담당·기한 자동 구조화 | STT가 막 도입돼 **다음 1순위 후보**. 회의 녹음→위키 자동화 |
| **전사적으로 묻기** | 여러 룸을 한 번에 질의(ACL 준수, 출처에 룸 배지) | 근거·라벨 일부 구현, 교차-scope 셀렉터 UI 미구현 |
| **전문가 라우팅** | 답 못 할 때 "○○님이 자료를 많이 올렸어요"(기여자 안내) | 설계 완료, 미착수 (순위표 아님·익명 제외) |
| **답변 신뢰도 신호** | "근거: 강/보통/약 — 단일 소스·오래됨" 칩 | 계산 로직 일부 구현, UI 통합 미완 |
| **용어 자동 링크** | 답변 안에서 등록 용어를 자동 링크·호버 정의 | 위키 페이지 링크는 됨, 답변 내 링크는 후속 |
| **채팅·메일 커넥터** | Slack/Teams/메일을 allow-list로 자동 인제스트 | **보안 경계가 무거워 보류** — 별도 보안 설계 선결. 현재는 수동 업로드로 90% 대체 |
| **정밀 화자분리(WhisperX)·로컬 Whisper·영상 키프레임·유튜브 URL** | STT 고급 확장 | **GPU/전용 API 결제 필요** → 보류. 1차는 오디오 전사로 충분 |
| **워커 프로세스 분리(설계 C)** | 트래픽 급증 시 워커를 별도 배포로 | 현재 단일 라이터로 충분, **미래 확장 경로**(설계만) |
| **resumable 청크 업로드·MinIO/S3 원본저장** | GB급·불안정망 대비 | 사내 신뢰망에선 우선순위 낮음. 인프라 도입 시 |

---

## 한 줄 메시지 (청중별)

- **경영진**: "핵심 파이프라인(자료 인제스트 → 출처 있는 답변 → 위키 누적)은 **운영 중**입니다. 무료 AI(Gemini)로 돌고 사내망 안에서만 동작합니다. 회의 지식화·전사적 질의 등 **확장은 설계 완료, 우선순위에 따라 순차 개발** 예정이고, 유료 AI·SSO는 결제·시큐리티 신호만 받으면 바로 켜집니다."
- **개발자**: "git-backed 위키 + 단일 라이터 워커 + 공급자 추상화가 코어. 운영은 Gemini/Groq, 비동기 큐(pg-boss) ON, 키워드+BM25 검색. 임베딩·유료 API·SSO·커넥터는 **플래그/설계로 분리**돼 회귀 없이 단계 도입 가능."

---
